name: vfx-anamorphic-flare
title: Anamorphic Streak Flare
description: Anamorphic light background: points of light in the brand red and white drift slowly, each throwing a long horizontal lens streak over the theme ground, brightest mid-way. Point colours, their share, streak tint, ground, intensity, threshold, streak length, bloom, drift and point count are variables; drifts or fades.
